tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
New Relic integrates AI tools with GitHub for real-time production telemetry. Reported by CXO Digitalpulse: this brings intelligent observability directly into developer workflows.
Mistral AI releases Mistral Large 4 with 41% Terminal-Bench 4.0 score and 30% fewer output tokens. Reported by XenoSpectrum: the open weights model shows better coding efficiency.
Anthropic's heavy spending on artificial intelligence could hold the key to profitability, according to analysis. Still open per CNBC: growth could justify the company's valuation.
Elizabeth Warren demands answers from Nvidia over reported spy ties and wants artificial intelligence technology kept out of certain hands. Still open per AOL: the senator is urging restrictions.
Honeywell launches Forge Plant Cognition with Dangote, built with artificial intelligence and Dell capabilities. Reported by DATAQUEST: the platform boosts refinery operations and value.
Free every hour.
